'''2000 Colorado State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Parker, Colorado on 29 April 2000. [[Kyle Craft]] won it. It is known from Kyle Craft's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d637">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-parker-colorado-4-29-00d637/ parker-colorado-4-29-00], DeckTech (Kyle "Jedi.02" Craft, 30 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-30-parker-colorado-4-29-00d637/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Parker, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kyle Craft]]
